steps.title: Add beads to tube
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1 mm beads followed by 200 µL of 0.5 mm beads to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1 mm beads to the tube
Add 200 µL of 0.5 mm beads to the tube

steps.title: Add buffers to tube
steps.instruction: Add 225 µL of TE buffer (stored at 4 °C) and then 375 µL of lysis buffer (stored at 4 °C) to the same 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 225 µL of TE buffer (4 °C) to the tube
Add 375 µL of lysis buffer (4 °C) to the tube

steps.title: Add sample to tube
steps.instruction: Collect 10–20 mg of the sample and add it to the 2 mL Eppendorf tube containing the beads and buffers.

steps.title: Crush sample in mixmill
steps.instruction: Place the 2 mL Eppendorf tube in a mixmill and run at 30 rpm for 4 minutes (00:04:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge tube
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 17.0 × g, 25 °C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 1
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of isopropanol to the first well of a 96‑well deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to well 1
steps.instruction: Shake the magnetic‑bead bottle, pipette, then add 125 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg/mL) to the first well of the 96‑well deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add lysate to well 1
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the lysate (centrifuged sample) to the first well of the 96‑well deep‑well plate (add this last).

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 2
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of isopropanol to the second well of the 96‑well deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add ethanol to wells 3‑4
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to each of the third and fourth wells of the 96‑well deep‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to well 3
Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to well 4

steps.title: Add water to well 5
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of double‑distilled (DD) water to the fifth well of the 96‑well deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Load plate into extraction machine
steps.instruction: Place the prepared 96‑well deep‑well plate into the automated DNA extraction machine.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate to tube
steps.instruction: Add 267 µL of 10 M ammonium acetate (stored at 4 °C) to the 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Collect eluted DNA
steps.instruction: After the extraction run completes, collect 100 µL of the eluted sample to use as DNA template for downstream experiments.
